summary: Your seventh Sunday review. You answer 8 questions on the model API, structured output, validation and streaming with a confidence number, fill in what the client sees on each of your three chat paths, group your confusions into 3 themes, tag week 7 and plan week 8.
goal: Explain structure, validation, streaming and the three paths of your chat, and plan week 8.

items.text: Self-test: answer the 8 questions with a 1 to 3 confidence number, then mark each one
Three paths: write what the client sees on each path, then check it against your tests
Error log: group this week's confusions into 3 themes and fix the top one with a 5-minute experiment
Catch up: tick every unfinished step of Day 43 to Day 49, in order
Run git tag week-7 and see tag: week-7 in git log --oneline --decorate
Plan week 8: write one outcome sentence, put 7 sessions in your calendar, and write your drop list
Play the Week 7 Mix-up game to the end and see your score
